definitions.explanation: the lowest possible point or state; often used figuratively to describe the worst circumstances in life, finances, or emotions

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}のどん{底|ぞこ}を{経験|けいけん}した。
examples.english: I experienced rock bottom in life.

examples.japanese: どん{底|ぞこ}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I climbed back up from rock bottom.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}がどん{底|ぞこ}に{落|お}ちた。

notes:
EXPRESSIVE NOUN:
どん{底|ぞこ} is an emphatic word for the absolute lowest point. The prefix どん～ intensifies {底|そこ} (bottom).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どん{底|ぞこ}を{経験|けいけん}する - to experience rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}に{落|お}ちる - to fall to rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がる - to crawl up from rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}{生活|せいかつ} - life at rock bottom
- どん{底|ぞこ}{状態|じょうたい} - state of being at rock bottom

CONTEXTS:
- {人生|じんせい}のどん{底|ぞこ} - rock bottom in life
- {経済|けいざい}/ビジネスのどん{底|ぞこ} - economic rock bottom
- {精神的|せいしんてき}などん{底|ぞこ} - emotional rock bottom

RELATED TERMS:
- {底|そこ} - bottom
- {谷底|たにぞこ} - valley bottom
- {最低|さいてい} - the lowest
